EnergyFM

[EnergyFM: Pretrained Models for Energy Meter Data Analytics]


Core Architecture & Models
- Backbone Design: Built on IBM Research's lightweight and TSPulse architectures.
[Tiny Time Mixers (TTM)]
- Energy-TTM: Adapted for short-term load and day-ahead electricity demand forecasting.
[EnergyFM/energy-ttm]
- Energy-TSPulse: Supports downstream tasks including anomaly detection, data imputation, and classification.
- Dataset Scale: Pretrained and curated using massive corpora (such as 1.26 billion hourly electricity consumption records across tens of thousands of buildings).


Key Features & Analytics Capabilities
- Lightweight & Efficient: Features compact parameter sizes (often starting under 1M–5M parameters), enabling execution on resource-constrained or CPU-only hardware.
- Transfer Learning: Facilitates strong zero-shot and few-shot adaptation across heterogeneous buildings, regions, and operational sectors without needing custom training per building.
- Disaggregation & Meter Analytics: Helps disaggregate load patterns, identify consumption anomalies, and process multi-scale temporal structures in smart meter data.
